common.notConfigured: Configure the server in Settings first

monitor.emptyDesc: Enter your server address and token in Settings to begin.
monitor.confirmStop: Stopping cannot be undone. Stop the print?

control.confirmHome: Homing moves the toolhead. Running it mid-print will ruin the current part. Continue?
control.gcodeNote: Raw G-code is disabled by default. Set ALLOW_RAW_GCODE=true on the server to enable it.

files.note: Imported files land in the root of the printer's SD card. Timelapse and recordings are written by the printer itself.
files.modelNote: Preview and figures come from the sliced file. The mesh itself is not loaded.
files.pickSlotFirst: Assign a slot to every filament first

check.filamentLow: {slot} has about {left} g left; this plate needs {need} g
check.nozzleMismatch: Sliced for a {want} mm nozzle; the printer has {have} mm
check.printerBusy: The printer is {state} and cannot start a new job
check.noSdCard: No SD card detected in the printer

slice.bed_temperature_too_high_than_filament: Bed temperature is above what this filament tolerates
slice.object_outside: A model extends outside the printable area
slice.toolpath_outside: Toolpath extends outside the printable area
slice.nozzle_hrc_checker: Filament is harder than this nozzle tolerates
slice.filament_is_not_compatible: Filament is not compatible with this printer

settings.serverNote: Tailscale MagicDNS name with a real Let's Encrypt certificate. Credentials stay on this device.
settings.clearDesc: This removes the address and token stored on this device.
settings.footer:
Bambu Lab P2S remote monitor
End-to-end encrypted over Tailscale. No cloud service in the path.
settings.pushTestNone: No sink delivered — check the bridge push config
settings.pushInstallDesc: iOS only allows notifications from apps added to the Home Screen. In Safari tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open this page from the icon.
settings.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support web push
settings.pushInsecure: Push requires HTTPS — use the Tailscale https address
settings.pushNoVapid: The bridge has no VAPID keys, so web push is unavailable
settings.pushDenied: Notification permission denied — allow it in system settings

import.fromFileHint: Pick a sliced .gcode.3mf from this device
import.fromLinkHint: The bridge downloads it — no mobile data used
import.note: The printer can only print sliced .gcode.3mf. Raw STL/STEP must be sliced on a computer first.
import.entryHint: Add a sliced file from this device or a link

del.title: Delete file
del.desc: This permanently removes “{name}” from the printer's SD card.

print.title: Start printing?
print.desc:
About to print “{name}”, plate {plate}.

The printer will start heating and moving immediately. Check that filament is loaded, the bed is clear, and someone can watch the first layer.
print.busy: The printer is busy and cannot start a new job
print.risk: Starting a print remotely means it runs unattended. Judge the risk yourself.

dry.title: Filament drying
dry.confirmStart:
Dry at {t}℃ for {h} hours.

The AMS will heat continuously. Check that only filament you want dried is inside.

blocker.printing: A print job is in progress
blocker.filamentLoaded: Filament is still in the extruder

dry.confirmUnload: This retracts the filament from the extruder back into the AMS. The nozzle heats to 210℃ first, which takes about a minute.
dry.confirmStopPrint: Stop the current print? It cannot be resumed.
dry.note: Without the AMS power adapter, drying only runs when the printer is idle and no filament is loaded.

err.title: Printer errors
err.hmsNote: HMS entries describe a condition that is still true and cannot be dismissed manually — the printer withdraws them once the condition is resolved.

history.title: Print history
history.unweighed: {n} job(s) had no filament figure and are not counted
